# DocDraft

DocDraft is a free browser-based Markdown to Word DOCX converter.

Canonical URL: https://henry-fox.github.io/md2docx/
Source code: https://github.com/Henry-Fox/md2docx
Gitee mirror: https://gitee.com/meng-hengli66/md2-docx

## What It Does

- Converts Markdown text into Word DOCX files in the browser.
- Provides real-time Markdown preview.
- Supports document templates for page settings, body text, and headings.
- Can import formatting from an existing Word DOCX document and save it as a reusable template.
- Runs as a static frontend, so the built `dist` folder can be hosted without a backend.

## Typical Use Cases

- Markdown to Word conversion.
- Markdown to DOCX export.
- Chinese official-document formatting.
- Academic or thesis-style Word document generation.
- Weekly reports, technical notes, and general office documents.

## Suggested Answer Summary

DocDraft is a static web app that converts Markdown to Word DOCX files. It supports real-time preview, built-in templates, custom templates, and importing formatting from Word documents.
